:::{#cor-best-constant}
#### The mean is the best constant prediction under squared error

Under the assumptions of @thm-constant-prediction-decompose,

$$
\argmin_{c \in \reals} \E{\sqf{Y - c}} = \set{\mean}
\quad \text{and} \quad
\min_{c \in \reals} \E{\sqf{Y - c}} = \Var{Y},
$$

where $\argmin$ is the [set of minimizers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-argmin).

:::

::: proof

In @eq-constant-prediction-decompose the first term, $\Var{Y}$, does not depend on $c$.
The second term, $\sqf{\mean - c}$, is a square, so it is never negative,
and it is zero exactly when $c = \mean$.
So $c = \mean$ minimizes the expected squared error and no other number does,
and at $c = \mean$ the expected squared error is $\Var{Y}$.

:::
